description: This file defines a command-line interface for configuring and running a proxy server for the litellm project. It includes functions for health checks, testing chat completions, and starting the server with uvicorn, gunicorn, or hypercorn, with options for SSL, database setup, and environment configuration.

classes.name: LiteLLMDatabaseConnectionPool
classes.description: Enum for database connection pool limits and timeouts

classes.name: ProxyInitializationHelpers
classes.description: Helper class with static methods for server initialization, health checks, testing, and server startup procedures

methods.name: _echo_litellm_version
methods.description: Prints the current version of litellm

methods.name: _run_health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check on the specified host and port

methods.name: _run_test_chat_completion
methods.description: Performs a test chat completion request to the proxy

methods.name: _get_default_unvicorn_init_args
methods.description: Returns default arguments for uvicorn server startup

methods.name: _init_hypercorn_server
methods.description: Initializes and runs a hypercorn server with SSL options

methods.name: _run_gunicorn_server
methods.description: Initializes and runs a gunicorn server with SSL options

methods.name: _is_port_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a given port is in use

methods.name: _get_loop_type
methods.description: Determines the event loop type based on platform
